Date : 11-05-2020 Heard Mr. K. Agarwal, learned Senior counsel, assisted by Mr. A. K. Sahewalla,
learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. B. Sarma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.
Also heard Mr. B. Gogoi, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2, the concerned Food Safety Officer of the case.
Both the matters have arisen out of C.R. Case No. 786/2013, which are now pending before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Nagaon.

Matters relate to alleged contravention of the provision of Sections 26(2)(i)/27(2)(c) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 punishable under Section 59 of the said Act for storing for sale as well as selling of unsafe Coca-Cola for human consumption within the meaning of Section 3(1)(zz) of the said 2006 Act.
On the prayer of Mr. B. Gogoi, learned counsel, the opposite party No. 2, the concerned Food Safety Officer is given 1 (one) week's time to file his affidavit in the matter.
The said opposite party No. 2 shall file his affidavit on or before 18.05.2020 by serving copies of the same on the counsel for the petitioners as well as the learned Public Prosecutor.
Thereafter, the petitioners may file their reply, if any, on or before 26.05.2020.
Page No.# 3/3 Till then (02.06.2020), the interim orders passed earlier in both the proceedings shall remain in force.
A true copy of this order shall be furnished by the concerned Court Master to the petitioners or to their authorized person for their necessary use.
